Definition: Does the government maintain a digital civil register?
Comments: Ghana’s Births and Deaths Registry provides online services and processes via its official website, indicating a digitized civil registration system exists but evidence suggests ongoing transition from paper to digital rather than fully digital nationwide.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more tax registers?
Comments: Ghana Revenue Authority maintains a taxpayer identification numbering system and online tax registration; individuals use the Ghana Card PIN as TIN from April 1, 2021 and can register via online portals, indicating a nationwide digital tax register capability.
